notes: Exploratory 33 x 65 x 48 current grid (15.5 times fewer cells than the reference), retaining all 99 parent modes, the 384 x 384 Cho grid, and the same 0.00025 s time steps. Current small scales and onset timing are not grid converged.
The paired cases share the same coarse-grid random current initialization. Its spectrum differs from the fine-grid noise realization, so this is not a strict resolution-convergence pair.
3 cm carrier, ka=0.11, initial wind age 16 s, six-second evolution. The surface wind stress grows as the square root of wind age; molecular water viscosity is 1.1e-6 m²/s.

Prescribed and evolving-wave cases share the same initial Lagrangian current and divergence-free Gaussian perturbations. This is a reduced, exploratory comparison, not a grid-converged reproduction of Wagner et al.

The parent contains 99 free modes (mx=3–5, my=-16–16) with gravity–capillary dispersion and reciprocal current refraction. Intrinsic cubic interactions are omitted; the dominant carrier has second-order geometry and scattered modes have first-order geometry. Cross-bound resonant responses are not modeled.

Wind stress acts on the Eulerian current and viscosity acts on UL minus projected wave pseudomomentum. This physical stress convention differs slightly from the imposed UL-gradient convention described in Wagner et al.
Cho uses 2.4 times molecular wave damping and feels parent boundary residuals, orbital motion, and surface-current transport. Cho does not feed back into the mean flow.
Native fields and checkpoints remain on Unity. Only derived movies, figures and compact diagnostics are public.
